tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Transcribe speech from a public video, optionally between start and end. Returns a transcript_id while processing in the background: call this tool again with transcript_id to check. When done, fetch text_url for timestamped plain text with source attribution; Markdown and JSON links are also provid

tools.name: get_video_info
tools.description: Title, uploader, duration, thumbnail and available qualities of a public video link (YouTube, Instagram, X / Twitter, TikTok, Bluesky, Facebook, VK, LinkedIn, Weibo, Twitch, Kick). Posts with several videos list each one as an item.

tools.name: download_video
tools.description: Prepare a video as MP4 (H.264 + AAC, plays everywhere), MP3, or a looping GIF of up to 10 s, and return a download link. The link works for 15 minutes after the last request. Long videos may still be preparing when this returns: then call check_download with the job_id. Counts against the caller's d

tools.name: check_download
tools.description: Wait for a download started by download_video and return its link when ready.

tools.name: share_video
tools.description: Prepare the video (or just the part between start and end) and return a short gimmeclip.com/w/… link anyone can open and play, kept for 30 days. Counts against the caller's daily limit (40 per IP, 200 with an API key) unless the same clip was shared before. If it returns a job_id, call share_video a

tools.name: edit_video
tools.description: Make an edited copy of part of a public video (up to 60 s between start and end): vertical 9:16 or square crop, burned-in captions of the speech and of other sounds such as "[dog barking]" (in the language spoken, or translated to English, Portuguese, Spanish), even loudness; with a prompt also AI-w

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_transcript, get_video_info · Private data: share_video · Public sink: share_video.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_transcript, get_video_info · Private data: share_video · Public sink: share_video

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_video_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Title, uploader, duration, thumbnail and available qualities of a public video link (YouTube, Instagram, X / Twitter, TikTok, Bluesky, Facebook, VK, LinkedIn, Weibo). Posts with several videos list each one as an item." → after: "Title, uploader, duration, thumbnail and available qualities of a public video link (YouTube, Instagram, X / Twitter, TikTok, Bluesky, Facebook, VK, LinkedIn, Weibo, Twitch, Kick). Posts with several videos list each one as an item."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
